muse--palette-hint-skills.txt.why: muse's command list marks the pointed command in bold (pointerBold). A plain read finds no pointer, the list does not walk, and the frame is lost: composer unknown, modal unreadable.
muse--palette-hint-skills.txt.propose: Upstream: a bold or reverse flag per cell run. Text only: none, the list has no pointer glyph.
muse--palette-hint-skills.txt.effect: HOTFIX: an idle box reads composer unknown, so a send is held or refused(not_free) and a probe can end probe_failed

muse--palette-hint.txt.why: muse prints an argument hint ('[<model-id>]') after a typed command in the colour of the box's rule. A plain read shows it as typed text.
muse--palette-hint.txt.propose: Upstream: cursor column. Text only: a bracketed run after a known command from the command list is the shape, but a typed bracketed argument is identical, which the colour rule exists to tell apart.
muse--palette-hint.txt.effect: HOTFIX: the draft shows more text than was typed, so a send that verifies the box can end typed_not_submitted

muse--prompt-hint.txt.why: muse shows a suggested prompt as its placeholder in the placeholder grey. 'Run the test suite and fix any failures' is a sentence a person could type, so a text rule alone would hide a real draft with that text.
muse--prompt-hint.txt.propose: Add the text to idle.placeholders.texts only with muse's list of suggestions in hand; judgement call, left to the architect.
muse--prompt-hint.txt.effect: HOTFIX: empty box reads as a draft, so a send is refused(draft_present) and a walky delivery stays held

oc--narrow--permission-always-bash.txt.propose: Upstream: the cursor position of the terminal, or a reverse or bg flag per cell run. Text only: none found, the chips show no pointer glyph in the captures.
oc--narrow--permission-always-bash.txt.effect: ask card lost: no tap answer from the phone; the pane is not free, so a send is refused, which is correct

pi--v110-tabs-compact.txt.why: On a read with no styling pi's status rows are told by text: the first row opens with the working directory and one of the first two carries pi's session cost (ask.ts textStatus). The PR 397 extension replaces pi's footer with its own row (`⎇ main`), which prints no cost, so the plain read finds no frame and the ask is lost. The modal reads unreadable: no card, and the pane is still not free.
